direct_public_primary_reads.authors: D. Huybrechts and R. P. Thomas
direct_public_primary_reads.locators: Introduction theorem p.2 and Corollary 3.4 p.14
direct_public_primary_reads.used_statement: For a perfect object on a separated Noetherian special fibre in a square-zero thickening embedded in a smooth ambient scheme, a perfect derived lift exists exactly when the full truncated Atiyah-Kodaira-Spencer product vanishes.
direct_public_primary_reads.hypothesis_boundary: No simplicity, stability, or trace replacement; this is first-order perfect-lift equivalence, not higher-order transport.

direct_public_primary_reads.used_statement: For a finite module over a Noetherian ring, ideal depth equals the first nonzero local-cohomology degree.
The distinguished closed-support localization triangle yields the restriction long exact sequence.
Module and sheaf derived local cohomology agree on affine schemes for a finitely generated support ideal.
